g.text: Function: SW700 enables or disables USB JTAG. ENABLE connects pin2 to JTAG_LOGIC_3V3; OFF connects pin2 to DGND. USB_SELECT_ENABLE_3V3 feeds the rotary common and U621 /MR. OFF disables both translator branches and all headstage switches. Stop host TCK, set OFF, select XEM or P1-P8, then ENABLE and wait at least50ms. USB remains powered.

g.desc: Function: SW700 enables or disables USB JTAG. ENABLE connects pin2 to JTAG_LOGIC_3V3; OFF connects pin2 to DGND. USB_SELECT_ENABLE_3V3 feeds the rotary common and U621 /MR. OFF disables both translator branches and all headstage switches. Stop host TCK, set OFF, select XEM or P1-P8, then ENABLE and wait at least50ms. USB remains powered.

BRK8310 A01,19May2022,sheet1 C4 retained, J3 removed: https://pins.opalkelly.com/downloads/442/download?category_id=3 .

g.text: U700/C700/R701/R700 from the inherited selector removed; U610 connects directly to MC2. R60010k remains the common pulldown. C&K/Littelfuse JS series,revVL01/14/26,JS202011JCQN DPDT circuit/SMT drawing: https://www.littelfuse.com/assetdocs/littelfuse-c-k-slide-js-series-datasheet?assetguid=aba42b08-0d2c-423b-813d-a2faa5a3bb14 . Only terminals1/2/3 used;5/6/7 NC.
